stories.title: Parrot Sound Actions - Extended Actions
stories.description: Add more sound-to-action mappings: toggle visibility, recenter, click, go back. Expand the repertoire of non-verbal mouse control.
acceptanceCriteria: Pop sound can trigger touch/click
Cluck sound can toggle MouseClock visibility
Tut sound can recenter clock at current position
Shush-shush (double) can go back to previous position
All new mappings respect debounce and overlay guards

stories.title: Lettered Line Overlay - Toggle and Clear Commands
stories.description: Add commands to toggle individual lines and clear all lines. Complete the line overlay control vocabulary.
acceptanceCriteria: 'line <letter> off' deactivates specific horizontal line
'verticals on/off' toggles vertical markers
'lines off' or 'clear lines' removes all active lines
Lines render above content but below other overlays

stories.title: Spiral Nudge - Sound Triggers
stories.description: Integrate spiral nudge with parrot sounds. Hiss advances spiral outward, shush reverses or pauses.
acceptanceCriteria: Hiss triggers spiral advance (next position)
Shush pauses, reverses, or steps inward
Debounce prevents runaway motion
Only active when a targeting overlay is showing

stories.title: Spiral Nudge - Visual Feedback and Reset
stories.description: Add visual feedback for spiral nudge: origin marker, optional trail. Add reset command to return to origin.
acceptanceCriteria: Origin point marked with visible indicator
Optional faint trail shows spiral path taken
'spiral reset' voice command returns to origin
Specific sound (e.g., pop) can also reset
Quick cancel stops all spiral motion

stories.title: Concentric Box - Core Rendering
stories.description: Implement concentric rectangle overlay as alternative to circles. Render axis-aligned boxes centered at cursor, each with distinct color.
acceptanceCriteria: Configurable number of concentric boxes (e.g., 5)
Each box has distinct color from COLOR_REGISTRY
Boxes are axis-aligned rectangles or squares
Size progression is configurable (linear or geometric)
Boxes render centered at cursor position

stories.title: Concentric Box - Directional Guides
stories.description: Add clock-style directional rays that intersect the boxes. Thin dashed lines at each clock hour angle help identify intersection points.
acceptanceCriteria: 12 directional rays drawn at clock-hour angles
Rays are thin and dashed (visual guides only)
Intersection points with boxes clearly marked
Optional labels at intersections or box boundaries

stories.title: Concentric Box - Target Computation
stories.description: Implement ray-rectangle intersection for targeting. Given (direction, box color) pair, compute and move to intersection point.
acceptanceCriteria: Voice command '<color> <letter>' targets box-direction intersection
Voice command '<color> <number>' works with numeric clock positions
Ray-rect intersection handles all angles correctly (edges and corners)
Cursor moves to computed intersection point

stories.title: Concentric Box - Display Mode Switching
stories.description: Add commands to switch between circle mode, box mode, and hybrid mode. Allow user to choose preferred overlay style.
acceptanceCriteria: 'clock circles' activates pure circular MouseClock
'clock boxes' activates concentric box mode
'clock hybrid' shows both circles and boxes
Mode preference can be saved in settings
Hybrid mode renders boxes more subtly behind circles
